title: qaasid mera qat leja ehsaan bada hoga
body:
qaasid mera qat leja ehsaan bada hoga
baba mera koofe me mehmaan hua hoga
qaasid mere baba ki pehchaan badi ye hai
abbas alam lekar baazu me khada hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
qaasid mere bhai ki shaadi ke yahi din the
hamshakle payambar hai sehra bhi bandha hoga
qaimo me qabar dena qaasid hu mai soughra ka
mere ghame furqat me ek shor macha hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
dene ko rakha kya hai lelijiyo tum jaakar
akbar ne mera tohfa eedi ka rakha hoga
